promotion_policy: A completed fold0 below 0.64 is rejected. Scores from 0.64 up to but not including 0.68 remain research-only and do not trigger strict OOF. A score >=0.68 enters the credible promotion region; then compare screened candidates before exact five-fold OOF. Any final archive still requires strict OOF, production refit, organizer-shaped runtime Check and private-HF SHA roundtrip.
